description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related functions for gathering system information such as CPU load, memory, hostname, and system version, with platform-specific code for Linux and macOS. It also includes system control functions like reboot and environment variable management.

classes.description: Class providing system information such as hostname, CPU load, memory, and system version, with platform-specific implementations.
